name: Technology & Programming
description: Understand how modern software is built, from interfaces and apps to the systems behind the internet.

name: AI & Data
description: Explore artificial intelligence, machine learning, data, and the technologies changing how we work.

name: Business & Entrepreneurship
description: Learn how companies find opportunities, create value, and turn ideas into sustainable businesses.

name: Finance & Economics
description: Make sense of money, markets, investing, inflation, and the forces shaping the global economy.

name: Psychology & Human Behavior
description: Explore why people think, feel, decide, remember, and behave the way they do.

name: Science & Space
description: Explore the universe, the laws of nature, and the surprising science behind everyday life.

name: Health & Wellness
description: Build a practical understanding of sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and everyday wellbeing.

name: Design & Creativity
description: Learn how visual thinking, storytelling, creativity, and design shape the world around us.

name: Communication & Languages
description: Become clearer, more persuasive, and more confident in how you communicate with others.

name: History & Culture
description: Travel through ideas, civilizations, discoveries, and events that shaped the modern world.

name: Philosophy & Critical Thinking
description: Question assumptions, examine arguments, and learn to think more clearly about difficult problems.

name: Career & Productivity
description: Develop practical skills for learning faster, working smarter, and navigating your career.
